message: Go runtime libraries (g*) cannot be linked for bare-metal targets. Please use pure C/Rust static libraries.
why: A bare-metal artifact runs without an operating system: no scheduler, no threads, no dynamic loader and no syscall layer. A Go runtime archive carries all of those assumptions in its machine code, so the firmware may link and still fail at the first goroutine switch. The g* prefix is the declared carrier of that runtime (legacy Go archive names are screened too), which is why the plan builder refuses the name instead of guessing at symbols.
fix: rebuild the network layer as a pure C/Rust static .a exposing an extern "C" bridge and link that instead
or drop --target and compile this unit natively on the host, where the Go runtime is available
